svg.title: Control Studio validates one PI on the corners of the range
svg.desc: Control Studio's validation runs each candidate on the nominal heater and on the four corner heaters of the range. Candidate A brings every heater from 35 to 36 degrees Celsius without passing the 37-degree limit and passes all eight corner cases; candidate B settles the nominal heater faster, in 10.3 seconds, but the heater with 8 kilowatts per degree Celsius and 1.2 seconds of delay peaks at 37.10 degrees Celsius and keeps swinging.
svg.text: Control Studio validates one PI on the corners of the range
Control Studio's validation of this project · setpoint 35 → 36 °C · heaters labelled heat loss (kW/°C) · delay · numbers answer the predictions
A passes all eight corner cases; worst error from 30 s: 0.0828 °C
B: 8 kW/°C, 1.2 s peaks at 37.10 °C and still swings at 60 s: the failed case
B settles the nominal heater in 10.3 s (A: 15.5 s)
